name: Interviews
description: Transcribes the active interview sequence on this Mac (whisper), finds each answer with the local AI model (Ollama, no internet), groups the answers by the interviewer's question, and puts them on a safe copy: one Chapter marker per question (a broad title, spanning the whole answer) and one Comment marker per small topic. About 20 minutes for an hour of interview. Then Cut, raise & trim answers raises each question's answer one track, removes the questions and dead bits in between and puts an adjustment layer named after each question over its answers (copy only).

inputs.label: Interviewee (optional)
inputs.placeholder: e.g. Tahnee, used in the outlines

inputs.label: Audio track (optional)
inputs.placeholder: e.g. A1; empty = all unmuted tracks

actions.label: Find answers and add markers
actions.confirm: Transcribe this sequence and find the answers on this Mac? It takes about 20 minutes for an hour of interview. A safe copy of the sequence is made and the markers go on the copy; the original is not changed.

actions.label: Cut, raise & trim answers
actions.confirm: On this TOOLKIT COPY: cut at every question's answer, move each answer up one track, remove everything between the answers (questions, crew chat, pauses) so the answers run back to back, move the markers with them and put an adjustment layer named after each question over its answers? Links are kept. Only the TOOLKIT COPY changes; no footage is deleted and nothing is saved.
